//: Generation sets for tools/codegen/types.ts. One set = upstream files generated (and resolved) together.
class: structs emitted as `class` (constructor takes all fields in declaration order); methods are added
by the hand port via `declare module` + prototype assignment (PORTING.md section 5).
hand: types whose definition is hand-written in the mirrored hand-port module; only re-exported (+ Debug if derived).
discriminant: fieldless enums that also get `<Enum>_discriminant` without explicit discriminants.
skip: types not generated at all (reported).
Names may be bare (`Token`) or module-qualified (`rustc_lexer::Token`).
auto_class: structs with an inherent impl (with fns) anywhere in the set are emitted as class too.
skip_notes: reason per skip entry; required for entries that name no item the probe sees (e.g. types defined inside macro_rules!).
derive_clone: emit clone_<T> for #[derive(Clone)] types (value-like Copy types: identity; Copy objects and tuples: copied; manual impl Clone: hand clone_<T>).
derive(Walkable) types of a crate get <crate>/walkable.gen.ts and <crate>/mut_walkable.gen.ts (always).
hand_notes: reason per hand entry (documentation only, not read by the generator).

derive_decodable / derive_encodable: emit decode_<T> / encode_<T> for derive(Decodable*) / derive(Encodable*) types (rustc_macros/src/serialize.rs; per-file sets next to the type, derive_only sets into <crate>/decodable.gen.ts); decodable_types limits them to the listed items; decodable_construct builds hand types that are not { field } objects (see tools/codegen/types.ts SetConfig).

erase_params: type parameters dropped from the TS types and from type arguments at their position (`I: Interner`, plan-m3 D3); `<I as Interner>::X` reads as `I::X`. resolve_files: probed for `use`/`mod` only (re-exports such as rustc_middle ty/mod.rs). typemap_extra: type-map files merged after the global map for this set only (tyir.typemap.json: `I::Ty` etc.). bitflags_debug: emit bitflags' derived Debug. derive_type_fold (+ type_fold_types): visit_with_<T> / try_fold_with_<T> / fold_with_<T> for derive(TypeVisitable[_Generic]) / derive(TypeFoldable[_Generic]) next to the type (tools/codegen/type_fold.json).

hand_notes.decodable_construct: branded newtypes are built with their `of` companion (LocalModId: new_unchecked); SourceFileHash is a class holding its `[u8; 32]` as a Uint8Array; ExpnData, ModId, RealFileName, Ident are classes (constructor takes every field in declaration order); StableSourceFileId.of wraps a decoded Hash128

hand_notes.*: rustc_middle's types are hand-written; this set only generates rustc_middle/stable_hash.gen.ts (derive(StableHash)) for the ported query value types listed in stable_hash_types (re-fed queries, calls.rs query_feed).
